Via Lake Huron and the Great Lakes system, it is part of the larger watershed of the St. Lawrence River.
Misteguay Creek begins in Clayton Township in Genesee County, approximately 1.9 miles (3.1 km) southeast of the village of Lennon and 3.5 miles (5.6 km) west of the city of Swartz Creek.
